VIDEO SCRIPT: WATER ITS RESOURCES
Grade: Grade 2 · Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Water its resources. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• Water is useful at home and school.
• Drink clean safe water.
• Do not waste water.

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Uses: drinking, cooking, washing, farming
• Safe storage: covered clean container
• Save water: close taps, fix leaks

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Name 5 uses of water.
• Tick safe vs unsafe drinking sources.
• Act out: washing hands the correct way (wet → soap → scrub → rinse → close tap).

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Water its resources.”
